en.title: EVA Air earns 2027 APEX Five Star rating and wins Best Wi-Fi in Greater China
en.summary: EVA Air earned 2027 APEX Five Star Global Airline recognition and the Greater China Wi-Fi award. The carrier lists three aircraft types with connectivity and details its satellite service limits.
body: The Airline Passenger Experience Association (APEX) listed EVA Air as a 2027 Five Star Global Airline. EVA Air also won Best Wi-Fi in Greater China at the regional ceremony on November 19 at Singapore’s Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre. The carrier announced both honours the following day.

Five Star status reflects passengers’ overall experience, while the Wi-Fi prize is a regional category. Qatar Airways won the global Wi-Fi category in the same awards cycle. APEX collected the feedback through TripIt by SAP Concur and drew on more than one million verified flight ratings across 722 airlines. The 2027 label follows the evaluation cycle completed in 2026.

EVA Air’s Taiwan website lists Panasonic Avionics Wi-Fi in every cabin on its Boeing 787, 777-300ER and Airbus A330-300 aircraft. The site describes complimentary full-flight browsing as a limited-time promotion. It supports web browsing and text messaging, with streaming, voice calls, VPNs and video conferencing excluded.

EVA Air says its satellite service is available above 10,000 feet. Coverage, the number of passengers online and weather can affect speeds, and the connection may drop in areas without satellite coverage.
EVA Air also received its 11th consecutive five-star rating from Skytrax in 2026. That streak belongs to Skytrax’s separate rating programme. APEX presented the awards announced in Singapore.

zh.title: 長榮獲 2027 APEX 全球五星航空　奪大中華區最佳機上 Wi-Fi
zh.summary: 長榮在新加坡獲列 2027 年度 APEX 全球五星航空，並拿下大中華區最佳機上 Wi-Fi。長榮官網列出提供服務的三款機型與衛星連線限制。
body: 長榮航空獲國際航空乘客體驗協會（APEX）列為 2027 年度全球五星航空，並在 11 月 19 日於新加坡濱海灣金沙會展中心舉行的區域頒獎典禮拿下大中華區最佳機上 Wi-Fi。長榮於翌日公布兩項獲獎消息。
全球五星航空是整體搭乘體驗的評等，機上 Wi-Fi 則是區域分項。同屆全球最佳機上 Wi-Fi 由卡達航空獲得。APEX 透過 SAP Concur 旗下的 TripIt 蒐集搭乘回饋，本屆採用來自 722 家航空公司的逾百萬筆經驗證航班評分。獎項冠以 2027 年度，評選週期在 2026 年完成。
依長榮台灣官網，波音 787、777-300ER 與空中巴士 A330-300 的各艙等提供機上 Wi-Fi，由松下航空電子（Panasonic Avionics）供應。官網列出的全程免費網頁瀏覽屬限時推廣，旅客可用來瀏覽網頁和傳送文字訊息，影音串流、語音通話、VPN 與視訊會議皆不支援。
這項服務仰賴衛星連線，長榮說明須在飛行高度超過 1 萬英呎後才能使用。衛星覆蓋、同時上網人數與天候都可能影響實際速度，飛越衛星訊號未涵蓋的區域時也可能中斷。
長榮另在 2026 年連續第 11 年獲 Skytrax 評為五星航空。這項連續紀錄屬於 Skytrax 的獨立評鑑，本次新加坡公布的獎項則由 APEX 頒發。

facts.claim: APEX held its annual awards ceremony in Singapore on November 19, 2026, where EVA Air won the 2027 APEX Five Star Global Airline award.
EVA Air also won Best Wi-Fi in Greater China at the same ceremony.
The APEX awards cover more than 600 airlines and draw on feedback from more than one million passengers, audited by an independent third party.
Judging covers five core indicators: seat comfort, cabin service, onboard catering, entertainment and connectivity.
EVA Air also earned an 11th consecutive SKYTRAX five-star rating this year and was named the 2026 world's best international airline by Travel + Leisure.
The 2027 APEX awards drew on more than one million verified flight ratings across 722 airlines.
EVA Air lists Wi-Fi on its 787, 777-300ER and A330-300 fleets, subject to satellite coverage and an altitude threshold.
